verdict.rationale: Stripe ships an official Link CLI for agentic commerce. It is documented in first-party docs, its source is public at github.com/stripe/link-cli, and a runtime probe confirms it on npm as @stripe/link-cli 0.19.2. The CLI is built for agents: it issues one-time-use credentials (virtual card, Link Pay Token, SPT), pays machine-payment endpoints via `npx @stripe/link-cli mpp pay`, and exposes `link-cli --llms-full` so agents can read its full documentation. The Stripe CLI is separately documented for coding agents to provision anonymous sandboxes with `stripe sandbox create`. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of real-world CLI usage.
